purpose: Determine whether post-v0.2.0 reference-mode closure, Accounting Spine recovery-boundary consolidation and associated reproducibility/governance work form a coherent public scientific-core milestone suitable for v0.3.0 without implying model completion, canonical Accounting Spine completion or behavioural validation.
substantive_changes_since_v0_2_0: Promoted sectoral_financial_positions to observed aggregate reference-mode status after a preregistered ECB QFA official-consistency gate, advancing required reference-mode observability from 9/10 to 10/10 without changing the bilateral Accounting Spine.
Completed BNR/OECD/ESA source-topology, semantic, precision, exact-decimal and window-stability diagnostics under retained-vintage and no-post-result-tolerance-relaxation governance.

Executed instrument-specific Accounting Spine selective-reopen cycles for F5-F8 from retained OECD counterpart evidence; each cycle was preregistered and returned to hold when frozen source-reconciliation gates failed before rank admission.

Closed the repeated standard BPM6/Eurostat/BNR Direct-Investment route for the missing F2 subinstrument at a standards-supported dissemination boundary, preserving F2M but leaving F21/total F2 incomplete.
Rejected a cross-domain Eurostat-financial-accounts minus ECB-BSI subtraction as an exact F4 BNR counterpart bridge, preserving the existing F4 partial core and unresolved BNR allocation.
Consolidated Accounting Spine recovery into a terminal evidence-triggered hold assessment with explicit reopen triggers for every incomplete instrument and no active unconditional recovery task.
Strengthened cross-registry baseline governance so release-version state and Accounting Spine terminal recovery state are CI-checked against their canonical contracts.
Updated README/STATUS/CHANGELOG to expose the current scientific boundary and reproducibility path without overstating model maturity.

release_classification.rationale: The post-v0.2.0 change set introduces a new public scientific boundary—10/10 aggregate reference-mode observability plus a terminal machine-checkable Accounting Spine recovery state—and substantial new reproducibility contracts. It is broader than a corrective patch, while RMD remains in initial development and does not claim a stable 1.0 API or complete endogenous behavioural model.

scientific_nonclaims: v0.3.0 does not mean the Accounting Spine is complete.
v0.3.0 does not mean all bilateral F2-F8 matrices are available.
v0.3.0 does not validate a behavioural reference mechanism.
v0.3.0 does not activate any System Dynamics feedback loop.
v0.3.0 does not activate behavioural closure.
v0.3.0 is not a calibrated forecasting or policy-simulation release.
